purpose: Open-source and public-standard sources used to normalize PhotoAtelier reference taxonomy.

sources.name: IPTC Photo Metadata Standard 2025.1
sources.reuse: Use IPTC-style descriptive, administrative and rights fields for reference assets.

sources.name: digiKam advanced search and metadata model
sources.reuse: Use DAM-style facets: tags, labels, ratings, date, location and metadata search.

sources.name: Alcedo Studio
sources.reuse: Borrow lightweight RAW/DAM workspace ideas: AI tags, natural-language search, keeper curation.

sources.name: Awesome Stock Resources
sources.reuse: Use license-based source categories for external photo/video resources.

sources.name: Awesome Open Source Photography
sources.reuse: Use photography workflow categories: RAW developers, organizers, EXIF editors, tethering, color correction, video tools.

sources.name: Shot Type Classifier
sources.reuse: Use the six cinematic shot sizes as normalized shot-size values.

sources.name: Movie Shot Classification Dataset
sources.reuse: Use camera movement classes for video and short-form reference notes.

sources.name: Image Composition Assessment Dataset CADB
sources.reuse: Use scene category, composition class, composition element and quality score ideas for reference scoring.

sources.name: G'MIC Film LUTs Collection
sources.reuse: Use film-emulation LUT library categories and .cube asset fields.

sources.name: Raw Alchemy
sources.reuse: Use explicit color-space pipeline fields before applying creative LUTs to photos.

sources.name: apply-cube-lut
sources.reuse: Use .cube parsing/application concepts for future preview and LUT matching.

sources.name: SDXL Style Reference
sources.reuse: Use public-domain photographic style prompt structure for AI previsualization.

adoptionPlan: Keep current Chinese shooting-specific fields, but add open-standard fields for interoperability.
Normalize shotSize and cameraMovement values to open filmmaking taxonomies.
Track licenseClass for every external source, especially stock and platform references.
Prepare future EXIF/IPTC/XMP read-write so final works can carry tags and captions outside the app.
Treat LUT entries as color pipelines, not just style names.
